columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Multi-agent escalation needs protocol-specific value and cost routing, not a single failure-risk gate
columns.title_zh: 多 Agent 升级不能只靠失败风险门禁，还需要 Protocol-specific Value 与 Cost Routing
columns.source_zh: arXiv 2608.14927 一手受控研究：固定 Solver、配对比较四种 Collaboration Protocol，并同时测量 Solve 与 Token Cost
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260906-006 after Skill 02 triage. The controlled study evaluates the same 4,181 competition-level math problems under four collaboration protocols while holding the solver fixed. Its post-answer probe predicts baseline failure strongly (0.8847 AUROC), yet protocol-specific value prediction for PER and Broadcast is much weaker (0.1674 and 0.1041 AUPRC), and routing policies trade under-escalation against expensive over-escalation. The bounded Digital Employee governance problem is therefore not whether to add more agents, but how to separate failure-risk admission, collaboration-topology choice and token-cost budget. This is a primary empirical finding with explicit paired comparisons and cost accounting, has stronger evidence depth than today's single-source runtime failure candidate, and is materially distinct from the recent authority, recovery and memory research objects.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260906-006。该受控研究在固定 Solver 的情况下，对同一批 4,181 个竞赛级数学问题分别运行四种 Collaboration Protocol。Post-answer Probe 对 Baseline Failure 的预测很强（0.8847 AUROC），但对 PER 与 Broadcast 的 Protocol-specific Value 预测明显较弱（AUPRC 分别为 0.1674 与 0.1041）；不同 Routing Policy 还会在 Under-escalation 与高成本 Over-escalation 之间权衡。因此，边界清晰的数字员工治理问题不是“要不要增加更多 Agent”，而是如何把 Failure-risk Admission、Collaboration Topology 选择与 Token-cost Budget 分开治理。该对象具有配对比较与成本核算的一手实证证据，证据深度高于今天的单来源 Runtime Failure Candidate，并且与近期 Authority、Recovery、Memory 研究对象存在实质新 Research Delta。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the four protocol definitions, 4,181-problem evaluation set, post-answer probe construction, routing policies, paired solve/cost measurements, AUROC/AUPRC interpretation, task-dependent protocol profiles, failure cases and limits on generalizing from competition math to operational digital-employee teams.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验四种 Protocol 定义、4,181 个问题的评估集、Post-answer Probe 构造、Routing Policy、配对 Solve/Cost 测量、AUROC/AUPRC 含义、任务依赖的 Protocol Profile、失败案例，以及从竞赛数学推广到实际数字员工团队时的边界。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Operational resilience must be evaluated by phase and trust-mediated coordination, not eventual recovery alone
columns.title_zh: 运行韧性必须按阶段与 Trust-mediated Coordination 评估，而不能只看最终恢复
columns.source_zh: 开放获取的一手 Agent-based Supply-chain 研究：在 Trust 与 Capacity Constraint 下比较分阶段 Resilience
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260906-007 after Skill 02 triage. The primary study models policy-driven load redistribution among capacity-constrained supply-network agents under trust-dependent local decisions and evaluates absorptive, adaptive, containment and recovery phases separately across multiple decision policies and network structures. The bounded Industry Architecture question is whether eventual completion/recovery is sufficient evidence of a healthy multi-agent organization, or whether governance must observe phase-specific resilience, trust and coordination behavior. This is a question-first industry application finding with comparative policy/network evidence and a clear temporal failure model. It adds a materially different operational-resilience research line from the recent connector-authority and delegation-chain architecture objects.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260906-007。该一手研究在 Trust-dependent Local Decision 与 Capacity Constraint 下，建模供应网络 Agent 之间由 Policy 驱动的 Load Redistribution，并分别评估 Absorptive、Adaptive、Containment 与 Recovery 阶段，同时比较多种 Decision Policy 与 Network Structure。边界清晰的行业架构问题是：最终完成或最终恢复是否足以证明 Multi-agent Organization 健康，还是治理必须进一步观察分阶段 Resilience、Trust 与 Coordination Behavior。该对象由问题驱动，具有 Policy/Network 比较证据和清晰的时序 Failure Model，与近期 Connector Authority、Delegation Chain 等架构对象形成实质不同的运行韧性研究线。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the agent-based model, trust and capacity semantics, network structures, policy classes, phase definitions and metrics, disruption experiments, reported heterogeneous outcomes, sensitivity/robustness evidence, and limits on transferring supply-network simulation findings to software-based digital-employee organizations.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Agent-based Model、Trust/Capacity 语义、Network Structure、Policy Class、阶段定义与指标、Disruption Experiment、报告的异质结果、Sensitivity/Robustness 证据，以及将供应网络仿真结论迁移到软件型数字员工组织时的边界。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Durable agent transitions need stable principal identity plus destination re-admission
columns.title_zh: Agent 的持久 Fork/Resume 既需要稳定 Principal Identity，也需要目标环境重新准入
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 的稳定 Agent Graph Identity 实现，并由 Codex Managed Worktree Fork Re-admission 的独立代码库实现交叉支持
columns.reason: Selected as a cross-implementation engineering problem anchored in SIG-20260906-004 and strengthened by SIG-20260906-003. OpenAI Agents SDK derives deterministic identity across the reachable agent graph so persisted RunState, nested approval/tool tracking and sandbox resume can reattach to the intended execution principal rather than transient objects or same-name collisions. Codex independently treats a managed-worktree fork as a re-admission boundary: destination configuration is reloaded, explicitly untrusted sources are rejected, active/queued source sessions cannot fork, developer-instruction mismatch blocks transfer, and the new thread is bound to the destination checkout. Together the two codebases support a bounded rule that identity continuity is necessary for durable state, but identity continuity must not imply automatic authority continuity across a workspace/session transition. Source-family concentration is penalized, yet the complementary mechanisms and tests provide more evidence than either implementation alone and the problem is materially distinct from recent checkpoint-alignment and approval-sign-off research.
columns.reason_zh: 作为跨实现工程问题选入，以 SIG-20260906-004 为锚点，并由 SIG-20260906-003 的独立代码库实现增强。OpenAI Agents SDK 为可达 Agent Graph 推导确定性 Identity，使持久化 RunState、Nested Approval/Tool Tracking 与 Sandbox Resume 能重新绑定到正确的 Execution Principal，而不是瞬时对象或同名冲突对象。Codex 则独立地把 Managed-worktree Fork 视为 Re-admission Boundary：重新读取目标 Configuration、拒绝显式 Untrusted Source、禁止 Active/Queued Source Session Fork、在 Developer Instruction 不一致时阻止迁移，并把新 Thread 绑定到目标 Checkout。两个代码库共同支持一个边界清晰的规则：Durable State 需要 Identity Continuity，但跨 Workspace/Session Transition 时，Identity Continuity 不能自动等同于 Authority Continuity。虽然按 Source Concentration 对同一厂商来源降权，但两项互补机制与测试提供了高于单一实现的证据，并且与近期 Checkpoint Alignment、Approval Sign-off 研究问题存在实质新 Research Delta。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must inspect both maintainer commits and tests, reconstruct the deterministic agent-graph identity inputs and collision handling, trace RunState/tool/sandbox resume bindings, then trace Codex fork trust/configuration/session gates and destination checkout binding. It must distinguish stable principal identity, state continuity, destination compatibility and execution authority, and state what same-vendor cross-implementation evidence cannot prove about heterogeneous runtimes.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验两个 Maintainer Commit 与 Test，重建 Deterministic Agent-graph Identity 的输入与 Collision Handling，追踪 RunState/Tool/Sandbox Resume 的绑定，再追踪 Codex Fork 的 Trust/Configuration/Session Gate 与 Destination Checkout Binding。必须区分 Stable Principal Identity、State Continuity、Destination Compatibility 与 Execution Authority，并明确同厂商跨实现证据不能证明哪些异构 Runtime 结论。
